name: $55M Whale Phishing
rootCause: A crypto whale lost over 55 million DAI from a MakerDAO vault after being tricked into signing a phishing transaction that transferred control of their DSProxy contract to an attacker, enabling the theft and laundering of the entire vault balance. The victim signed a phishing transaction that changed the owner of their DSProxy contract, granting the attacker full control over the Maker vault and access to generate and withdraw all available DAI.

descriptions.text: A crypto whale lost over 55 million DAI from a MakerDAO vault after being tricked into signing a phishing transaction that transferred control of their DSProxy contract to an attacker, enabling the theft and laundering of the entire vault balance. The victim signed a phishing transaction that changed the owner of their DSProxy contract, granting the attacker full control over the Maker vault and access to generate and withdraw all available DAI.

On August 20, 2024, a phishing attack against a whale's DeFi Saver-managed Maker vault on Ethereum enabled an attacker to steal 55.47 million DAI. The attacker tricked the victim into signing a proxy ownership transfer, then withdrew all vault funds. The victim signed a transaction on a phishing replica of the DeFi Saver interface, unknowingly transferring ownership of their Maker vault's proxy contract to the attacker's address, who then drained the vault. No smart contract bug was involved.
